source.interpretation: The manual describes an AUTOM station's own stock as available during isolated periods and uses a shared bidirectional transport profile to represent reconnection. The installed native log must establish the actual local spare and later replenishment path for this one seed.

predeclared_native_acceptance: Derive exactly from accepted E11 base: change only ProblemDescription and BASE-01 StockAllocation.STSIZ 0 to 1 for TEACH-LRU-01. The depot stock, fault/repair, same PFRMS/PTOMS policy, two h0-9/h11-36 windows, ordinary time inputs, mission calendar, seed and collection must remain identical. Authored populated tables must roundtrip exactly.
Converter must have zero errors and nonempty valid SXO, event log and JSON report. Explain any warning beyond the E11 base #108/#2076/#2077. Process exit status alone is insufficient.

Identify the first fault and its physical failed ID. For a positive local-stock claim, an opening base spare must be present before the h9-11 gap and be taken from local stock for the h10 repair demand. The system should complete its replacement using that physical spare before h11 reconnection without waiting for depot delivery; no local backorder should accrue for that first demand.

Trace any resupply order created when local stock falls below nominal; it may legitimately queue across the isolated interval and move at reconnection. Do not assume that local satisfaction eliminates depot traffic or that an inventory reorder is the same as a system backorder. Reconcile physical IDs, upward failed-item transfer, repair, stock at both stations, and all transport starts/arrivals through horizon.

Compare the accepted zero-local-stock parent with the child across all 72 half-hour SystemResults and StockTotalResults bins, all missions, metrics, resource use, and terminal readiness, backorder, inventory and in-transit state. An altered later random stream or an unexpected report interpretation requires explicit explanation before acceptance.

Run guarded session-0 SSH under Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue, preserve active GUI PID 13340 through every hidden native step, seal raw artifacts, and require a separate read-only reviewer replay without importing the author's checker.
limits: One local spare versus none, one first fault, one isolation interval, one seed and one support link. This does not establish multiple-fault stock exhaustion, exact h9/h11 boundary priority, larger stocks, special routes, GUI visual behavior or cross-engine parity.
Remaining E11 variants and Issue #18 stay open.
